title: What the live paper record shows
description: The engines' own state, read from the running record: what is open, what closed, and what the market filter is doing right now.
body:
Every position in this record is a paper signal. No real orders are placed anywhere in this record. The figures below are read from the running record as of 2026-11-07T02:38:40.573Z, and the same numbers appear on the performance page, in the signal log, and in the status posted to the channel.

## Paper signals only

This record contains paper signals only. No real orders are placed anywhere in this record. v005 counts its live record from 1 October 2026 and v006 from 9 October 2026. The live record is short, and a losing start is the expected case rather than a surprise. In testing, losses were common and the average winner was roughly +19%, so a losing start is the expected case rather than a surprise. A single trade says nothing about a strategy.

The initial live signal was an ATOM entry at 2.066 after the 10 October 2026 daily close. ATOM exited below its 10-day low at the 18 October 2026 close, at 1.703, which is −17.9% after the 30 bps round trip. The entry price was 2.066 and the exit price was 1.703. The exit was triggered below the 10-day low, and the recorded result is −17.9% after the 30 bps round trip.

A NEAR entry at 5.896 on 12 October 2026 has been open since. That entry price is 5.896 and that entry date is 12 October 2026. The NEAR entry is recorded as open, while the engine snapshot shows 0 positions open for htf-rsi-v007, trend-daily-v005, and trend-daily-v006.

For trend-daily-v006, 7 closed trades with an average -13.34% net per trade is the recorded measurement. 4 closed trades is a small sample, 6 closed trades is a small sample, and 7 closed trades is a small sample; none of these counts supports a performance conclusion. The averages are records of completed trades only.

ATOM is one closed trade described in detail. It entered at 2.066 after the 10 October 2026 daily close and exited below its 10-day low at the 18 October 2026 close, at 1.703. That measurement is −17.9% after the 30 bps round trip. The ATOM figure explicitly includes the 30 bps round trip. htf-rsi-v007 reports an average null net per trade as shown in the record.

## Market filter and breakout distances

trend-daily-v005 has the Bitcoin market filter off. trend-daily-v006 has the Bitcoin market filter off. Both show 0 positions open on paper in the snapshot. The closest 20-day breakout distances recorded for trend-daily-v005 are:

ETHUSDT is the farthest of the three listed, at 9.50% below its high. BNBUSDT is between those two, at 8.71% below its high. These are distances to the 20-day breakout as recorded. They are not statements about future movement. The filter being off and 0 positions being open are both part of the same snapshot.

NEAR at 5.896 on 12 October 2026 has been open since, while the snapshot shows 0 positions open for htf-rsi-v007, trend-daily-v005, and trend-daily-v006.
